_comment: A LISTED COLLECTION in the Studio (not a pinned singleton) — the sibling convention for a
repeatable type. The committee can add, remove and reorder steps without a developer.
WHY A DOCUMENT TYPE AND NOT AN ARRAY ON THE SINGLETON:
F2's spine is the exhibitor journey, and the number of stages is exactly the thing SAOC's
committee is most likely to change (research Section 2: staging windows vary from a single
afternoon to two days depending on show size). An array on the singleton would work, but a
document type gives each step its own Studio URL, its own edit history, and its own
confirmation status the committee can flip one at a time as it settles each stage. It also
matches how the visitor stream modelled showFaq, for the same reason.

fields.name: when
fields._note: Free text, not a date, for the same reason showExhibitorDate.dateNote is. e.g. 'Before the entry deadline'.

fields.name: order
fields._note: GROQ orders by this ascending. Seeded 1..7 in tens (10,20,...) so the committee can insert a step between two without renumbering everything.

fields.name: active
fields._note: Lets the committee retire a step without deleting its edit history. The query filters on it; the contract proves an inactive step does not render.

seededSteps.title: Decide to enter
seededSteps._research: Section 1 — exhibitors register plants under an Exhibitor Number matched against a published Show Schedule.

seededSteps.title: Enter by the deadline
seededSteps._research: Section 1 — near-universal that an entry cutoff exists; the interval is show-specific, so the SAOC date is pending.

seededSteps.title: Prepare and label your plants
seededSteps.when: In the weeks before the show
seededSteps._research: Section 5 — pest/disease freedom and correct nomenclature are both near-universal.

seededSteps.title: Deliver and stage
seededSteps.when: During the staging window, before the show opens
seededSteps._research: Section 2 — a fixed pre-opening staging window is near-universal; SAOC's times are not set.

seededSteps.title: Judging
seededSteps.when: After staging closes, before the public are admitted
seededSteps._research: Section 4 — judging between staging and opening, exhibitors normally not present, 'Do Not Judge' opt-out.

seededSteps.title: During the show
seededSteps.when: The full run of the show
seededSteps._research: Section 8 — watering and care responsibility during the run was not found in ANY public exhibitor document. This step is mostly a question.

seededSteps.title: Removal
seededSteps._research: Section 2 — plants remain benched for the full run is near-universal; the removal time itself is SAOC's to set.

showExhibitorStepsQuery.name: showExhibitorStepsQuery
showExhibitorStepsQuery.groq: *[_type == "showExhibitorStep" && active == true] | order(order asc){ _id, title, when, body, order, status }
showExhibitorStepsQuery._note: active == true, not !defined(active) || active — initialValue guarantees the field is set on anything created through the Studio, and the seed sets it explicitly.
